status: The earlier full-cohort contact benchmark and its aggregate outcomes are known. These are separately registered retrospective follow-ups on its deposits. Selection, matched-control allocation and PLM optimization consume sequence inputs only. Check source and distance matrix hashes from the historical aggregate before geometry assessment.

plm.eligibility: From fixed cohort mask retain sites with >=98% canonical complete coverage across enrolled rows. Sort within each role by ascending SHA256(ASCII('followup-plm-v1/'+system+'/'+role+'/'+decimal reference position)), then position. Use first 64, partition in order into eight disjoint groups of eight sites. If any role lacks 64 eligible sites, report shortfall and stop that cohort. Coordinates are chosen without marginal or interaction score ranks and without structure labels.
plm.design: 64 joint 24-site panels. For i,j=0..7 use A group i, B group j and C group (i+j) modulo 8. Each possible intercomponent pair among the 64 chosen positions per role is tested exactly once. Masks and row support vary across panels, and each APC is panel-and-interface specific. Pooled ranking across panels is descriptive.
plm.shared_support: Within each panel use positive-weight rows canonical at all 24 positions for PLM, MI and joint mfDCA. Require >=ceil(N/2) rows inclusive, else record entire panel unavailable. Score raw and APC for all three methods, compare only common finite scores on measured labels. Record input/complete row count and hash, target fit statuses, iterations/residuals, constants, finite pairs and unknowns. Do not replace failed targets/panels or missing structure labels.
plm.budget: Static native preflight for each panel, up to four single-threaded panel processes, each capped at 256 MiB native workspace and 256 MiB scratch. At most 128 panel fits total. Keep all convergence failures and explicitly report any unexecuted panels if hard 4 hour wall allowance is exhausted. No result-based stopping.
plm.baseline: Native pair-complete MI now on same complete panel rows; joint observed-canonical mfDCA ridge 0.1, no shrinkage, no gaps, same panel and rows. APC per 8x8 interface block after estimation. All six raw/APC outputs required. These panel baselines differ from the older full-panel estimates.
plm.evaluation: Use the original model/assembly/copy and heavy-atom contact convention. Primary <=8 Angstrom, sensitivity <=5/10 Angstrom. Full observable/positive/unknown and common eligible/observable counts, per interface and pooled tie-grouped AP/AUROC, natural prevalence, unconditional top10/50 known positive/negative/unknown counts and lower/upper bounds. Equal-interface macro when both classes exist. Declare empty or single-class measures undefined. No independent-pair or across-population confidence intervals. Compare average precision improvement PLM-APC minus MI-APC and mfDCA-APC on identical denominator. Confirm sample coupling norms via sink and AUROC via independent rank sums.

triplets.scope: Both frozen cohorts, same eligible coordinate axes as the full pair-score benchmark, each named copy separately. Select 8192 distinct ABC triples per system by sampling uniform flat Cartesian indices without replacement with NumPy Generator(PCG64(638291)), reinitialize separately per system. Unravel in C order with ascending retained reference axes; sort flat IDs before processing.
triplets.statistic: Use full aligned cohort, uniform weights, jointly canonical rows, minimum ceil(N/2). At each site encode its cohort-wide modal canonical residue (break ties alphabetically) vs other canonical residues; exclude missing. Each site must have two observed bins on joint rows. Fit native M1/M2/M3 IPF on 2x2x2 with total uniform prior mass 1; max 1000 iterations, max absolute pair-marginal residual 1e-8. Calculate connected information KL(p3||p2) in bits. Screen or fitting failures are counted. Record greatest marginal error. This bounded two-state resolution is part of the estimand.
triplets.pair_baseline: Use the mean of the three within-interface percentile midranks of frozen full-cohort uniform mfDCA-APC scores. Rank over all finite entries of each interface using (midrank-0.5)/n. Report its AP/AUROC and those of connected information over the same observed, finite sampled triples for >=2 contacts at <=8 Angstrom. Cases are the largest floor(0.10*n_valid) finite connected-information values, tie by flat coordinate ID. All remaining sampled eligible triples form the control pool.
triplets.covariates: Seven sequence-only matching features in [0,1]. Use joint support fraction, raw unweighted canonical Shannon entropy divided by log2(canonical alphabet size) for A, B, C, then the separate frozen AB, AC, BC pair-score percentiles. Entropy uses marginal canonical observations for each site. Before any geometry lookup process cases in descending connected information then ascending ID. For each choose one unused control and require absolute calipers [0.08,0.15,0.15,0.15,0.15,0.15,0.15]. Minimize sum of squared caliper-normalized differences; tie by smallest flat ID. No widening, replacement, geometry/occupancy filtering or score-guided manual matching.
triplets.balance: Report total drawn, numerical/coverage eligibility, tail/control-pool sizes, matched and unmatched counts, mean covariates for all and matched groups, before/after standardized mean differences (pooled group variance, label undefined at zero variance), maximum absolute matched difference per variable, and connected-information/mean pair-baseline distributions in matched groups.
triplets.geometry: Join frozen matched IDs to full experimental distances only after hashing sequence-only selection. Complete means all three edges observed. At 8 Angstrom classify complete triples as zero/one/two/three close edges; two is a wedge and three is a triangle. Primary paired comparison is candidate minus control fraction with >=2 close edges among pairs where both triplets are observable. Secondary paired mean difference in maximum of the three intercomponent heavy distances, in Angstrom, alongside per-group medians. Report unknowns separately, per-group lower/upper event rates across all matched pairs, discordant cells, baseline comparative rankings, and repeat wedge/triangle rates at 5/10 Angstrom. No geometry-conditioned replacement. Descriptive only, repeated residues, copies and genomes preclude iid-binomial inference. Closed triples are structural geometry and do not measure energetic epistasis.
triplets.fixture: Hand-calculate deterministic matched control choice including caliper refusal, tied distance ordering, unmatched case, occupied control reuse prevention, complete/unknown topology and paired geometric difference. Verify IPF positive XOR / null independent binary fixture independently and verify direct geometry for an outcome-blind coordinate sample.
